versions.changelog: v0.3.2: 添加完整安全声明(Security Declaration)，明确声明只读文件列表、写入范围、命令白名单机制、网络访问策略、无副作用保证，降低ClawHub可疑标记
fix: 修复所有 Markdown 文件的 CDATA 标签导致渲染异常
v0.3.0: 新增规划能力和幻觉控制维度(12→14维度)，修复全部评分公式归一化，扩展反作弊探针(7→15)，新增6项测试(28→34)，对齐CLEAR/T-Eval/Anthropic行业标准

Version 0.2.1

- Added scripts/state_probe.py for new state probing and reliability checks.
- Made minor updates to existing scripts and configuration files for improved robustness.
- Documented that LLM Judge option now only triggers external API calls when explicitly enabled with --llm-judge.
- No breaking changes; all previous usage and report formats remain supported.
v0.2.0: 12维度独立评分公式, 28项测试, 多数据源融合, LLM Judge, pass@k, 反作弊探针
